research.title: Energy Hubs & Eco-Industrial Parks
research.details: Designing and operating systems that couple electricity, heat, gas, and hydrogen in a single scheduling problem — from integrated energy hubs to eco-industrial parks where co-located plants trade energy and material streams. Incorporates biomass-to-hydrogen, power-to-gas, LNG-fuelled oxy-fuel combined cycles, carbon capture, and small modular reactors.

research.title: Microgrid Operation & Energy Management
research.details: Real-time operation and scheduling for isolated microgrids and hydrogen refuelling stations that pair renewable generation with hybrid storage. Learning-based policies — supervised strategies and generative adversarial imitation learning — keep dispatch decisions fast enough for online use.

research.title: Optimization under Deep Uncertainty
research.details: Multi-objective frameworks that hold up when renewable output, demand, and prices cannot be forecast reliably. Information-gap decision theory trades guaranteed performance against tolerance to forecast error without assuming a probability distribution.

research.title: LLMs for Energy Management
research.details: Exploring how large language models can support energy system operation: interpreting heterogeneous operational and market data, reasoning over scheduling constraints stated in natural language, and assisting dispatch decisions for the smart grid alongside conventional optimization.

researchIntro: My research interests are mathematical optimization and large language models for energy management — spanning energy hubs, eco-industrial parks, microgrid operation, decision-making under uncertainty, and AI-driven energy management for the smart grid.
